sources.title: Combining drugs that bypass p53 to treat TP53-mutated leukemias
sources.verified: The abstract describes teriflunomide/DHODH inhibition, pyrimidine reduction and terminal differentiation in HMA-resistant TP53-mutated AML, including adaptive salvage and schedule-dependent effects.
sources.boundary: This is prior AML research on the same drug/mechanistic family. It does not by itself establish the new proposals on cytarabine-residual or salvage-poor AML, their exposure assumptions, or novelty.
